title: Why Hadza Guts Carry More Species Than American Guts
hook: A fiber gap helps explain the richer gut—and antibiotics add pressure.
closing: Fiber feeds gut diversity, while unnecessary antibiotics can erase what diet supports.
question: How much fiber did you eat?

segments.say: The Hadza carry about 730 gut bacteria species. Their gut community is far richer than the average American's.
Hadza fiber intake reaches 150 grams daily. Their gut bacteria receive far more fuel than the American average.
Likely unnecessary prescriptions make up 34 percent of outpatient antibiotics. Medicine adds another pressure beyond fiber intake.
